[{"bbox": [85, 74, 582, 90], "category": "Page-header", "text": "KHANG DIEN HOUSE TRADING AND INVESTMENT JOINT STOCK COMPANY"}, {"bbox": [562, 97, 687, 112], "category": "Page-header", "text": "Form B 09 - DN/HN"}, {"bbox": [85, 125, 555, 141], "category": "Section-header", "text": "## 2 SUMMARY OF SIGNIFICANT ACCOUNTING POLICIES (continued)"}, {"bbox": [85, 154, 212, 168], "category": "Section-header", "text": "### 2.9 Fixed assets"}, {"bbox": [130, 182, 347, 198], "category": "Section-header", "text": "#### Tangible and intangible fixed assets"}, {"bbox": [129, 211, 688, 314], "category": "Text", "text": "Fixed assets are stated at historical cost less accumulated depreciation or amortisation. Historical cost includes any expenditure that is directly attributable to the acquisition of the fixed assets bringing them to suitable conditions for their intended use. Expenditure which is incurred subsequently and has resulted in an increase in the future economic benefits expected to be obtained from the use of fixed assets can be capitalised as an additional historical cost. Otherwise, such expenditure is charged to the consolidated income statement when incurred in the year."}, {"bbox": [129, 327, 190, 342], "category": "Section-header", "text": "#### Disposals"}, {"bbox": [129, 355, 687, 399], "category": "Text", "text": "Gains or losses on disposals are determined by comparing net disposal proceeds with the carrying amount of the fixed assets and are recognised as income or expense in the consolidated income statement."}, {"bbox": [129, 413, 311, 428], "category": "Section-header", "text": "#### Depreciation and amortisation"}, {"bbox": [129, 441, 687, 485], "category": "Text", "text": "Fixed assets are depreciated and amortised using the straight-line basis so as to write off the depreciable amount of the fixed assets over their estimated useful lives. The estimated useful lives of each asset class are as follows:"}, {"bbox": [129, 498, 532, 572], "category": "Table", "text": "
Buildings and structures10 - 20 years
Machinery3 - 10 years
Motor vehicles6 - 10 years
Office equipment3 years
Computer software3 - 10 years
"}, {"bbox": [129, 584, 688, 615], "category": "Text", "text": "Land use rights with indefinite useful life are recorded at historical cost and are not depreciated."}, {"bbox": [129, 630, 279, 645], "category": "Section-header", "text": "#### Construction in progress"}, {"bbox": [129, 660, 688, 783], "category": "Text", "text": "Construction in progress represents the cost of assets in the course of installation or construction for production, rental or administrative purposes, or for purposes not yet determined, are carried at cost, which are recorded at cost and comprise of such necessary costs to construct, repair and maintain, upgrade, renew or equip the projects with technologies as construction costs; equipment cost; compensation; project management expenditure; construction consulting expenditure; and capitalised borrowing costs for qualifying assets in accordance with the Group's accounting policy. Depreciation of these assets, on the same basis as other fixed assets, commences when they are ready for their intended use."}, {"bbox": [85, 799, 239, 814], "category": "Section-header", "text": "### 2.10 Operating leases"}, {"bbox": [129, 829, 687, 875], "category": "Text", "text": "Leases where a significant portion of the risks and rewards of ownership are retained by the lessor are classified as operating leases. Payments made under operating leases are charged to the consolidated income statement on a straight-line basis over the term of the lease."}, {"bbox": [379, 984, 394, 997], "category": "Page-footer", "text": "17"}]
